enderchestview.page.title: Ender Chest Snapshot
enderchestview.option.ender_chest_enable: Whenever you open an ender chest, a copy of its 27 slots is saved locally; you can view the most recent snapshot at any time.
enderchestview.option.ender_chest_button: Shows an ender chest viewer button on the inventory screen; click it to open the latest snapshot.
enderchestview.option.ender_chest_view.t: Opens the ender chest snapshot viewer showing the contents saved the last time you opened an ender chest (read-only).
enderchestview.screen.ender_chest.title: Ender Chest Snapshot
